name: Dana Biosphere Reserve
story: Dana Biosphere Reserve is Jordan's largest nature reserve, located in south-central Jordan. Founded in 1989, it covers 308 square kilometres. The reserve crosses four bio-geographical zones and is home to hundreds of plant and animal species.
matters: It shelters threatened species like the Nubian ibex and caracal. The diverse environment is the southernmost area in the world to host the Mediterranean cypress.
